messages:
maria: Quick note — I'm opening a small PR to refresh the 'first-click' quickstart (hello world + auth + first deploy). Swapping old env var names, replacing the curl example with an SDK snippet, and fixing one broken anchor. PR is github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4129.

tom: Can you paste the new SDK snippet here? want to make sure serverless and container examples stay consistent.

maria: Sure — new node example (keeps it minimal):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-rt-1', prompt: 'hello' });
console.log(res.text);
```

jamal: looks good. only ask: did you update the env var name in the dockerfile example too? some users copy-paste.

maria: yep — changed `REDSYS_TOKEN` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY` across the page and in the docker run snippet. also tightened wording around token handling + link to best-practices.

elyse: small request — our canonical container image name changed (redwood/hello:latest). can you swap that in the Deploy section? I can follow up if you prefer.

maria: done in the branch. i left a TODO for the edge-case about ephemeral keys.

docs-bot: ci:docs check — docs build passed for PR #4129 :white_check_mark:

tom: assigning myself as reviewer — will skim the CLI and deploy steps end-to-end.

maria: thanks @tom — added you as reviewer and fixed one broken anchor under "auth/setup" (was pointing to #auth-setup-old).

jamal: :thumbsup: If it's just the snippet + anchor + var rename i'm ok to merge after tom's review. Do we want a short migration note for SDK3 -> SDK4?

elyse: yes, please add 2 lines under "Migration notes" pointing to /sdk/migrate and call out the `client.set_api_key(...)` -> `new Redwood({ apiKey })` change.

maria: added a short blurb and a link to /sdk/migrate. pushed. anyone else?

tom: one tiny nit — in your snippet use `client.setApiKey(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)` -> in the new SDK the ctor accepts the key. i'll push a one-line commit to match the API.

maria: ok pushed and will merge when CI green. cc @docs-bot for publish.

docs-bot: publish:docs scheduled — staging will pick up the change in ~10m.
